name: Modification Processing Status 1 Code
definition: Specifies the status of a cancellation request.

PACK.name: Accepted
PACK.definition: Modification request has been acknowledged for further processing by the account servicer.

REJT.name: Rejected
REJT.definition: Modification has been rejected for further processing.

MODP.name: Pending
MODP.definition: Modification is pending. It is not known at this time whether modified can be executed.
